episodes.name: The Book of Reconstruction: Chapter One
episodes.overview: Jefferson Pierce is still mourning the death of his long-time friend Detective Henderson. Meanwhile, Gambi is presented with an interesting opportunity. Lastly, Lynn and Jefferson are still not able to see eye to eye.

episodes.name: The Book of Reconstruction: Chapter Two: Unacceptable Losses
episodes.overview: The war between the 100 and the Kobra Cartel rages on. Meanwhile, Lynn continues to be concerned about Jefferson and Jennifer's curiosity is piqued by a new boy at school.

episodes.name: The Book of Reconstruction: Chapter Three
episodes.overview: Jefferson is feeling even more lost after a frustrating therapy session. Meanwhile, Anissa continues to care for a still comatose Grace. Lastly, Lynn has a breakthrough.

episodes.name: The Book of Reconstruction: Chapter Four
episodes.overview: Jefferson pays Tobias a visit and warns him to stay away from his family.

episodes.name: The Book of Ruin: Chapter One: Picking Up the Pieces
episodes.overview: Gambi supports Black Lightning as he departs on a special mission. Meanwhile, Grace tries to persuade Anissa to let her guard down.

episodes.name: The Book of Ruin: Chapter Two
episodes.overview: Jefferson crosses a line with Lynn. Anissa shares some important news. Tobias makes a surprising move.

episodes.name: Painkiller
episodes.overview: After attempting to bury the darker, devastatingly lethal Painkiller part of his persona, Khalil Payne has distanced himself away from everyone he knows and loves in a new city, Akashic Valley, in order to find peace... but peace never comes easy for men with pasts like Painkiller.

episodes.name: The Book of Ruin: Chapter Three
episodes.overview: The FBI pays Jefferson a visit. Meanwhile, Anissa surprises Grace.

episodes.name: The Book of Ruin: Chapter Four: Lyding
episodes.overview: Gambi warns the Pierce family of a possible crisis looming.

episodes.name: The Book of Reunification: Chapter One: Revelations
episodes.overview: Black Lightning sends Gambi an SOS. Meanwhile, Lynn finds herself in some serious trouble.

episodes.name: The Book of Reunification: Chapter Two
episodes.overview: Jefferson takes Khalil up on his offer to help. Meanwhile, Lynn finds herself wrestling with what could be the biggest decision of her life. Lastly, Tobias follows through on a hunch.

episodes.name: The Book of Resurrection: Chapter One: Crossroads
episodes.overview: Jefferson realizes that sometimes, an admission of weakness can be a show of strength. Meanwhile, Tobias is focusing on an end game.

episodes.name: The Book of Resurrection: Chapter Two: Closure
episodes.overview: After four seasons, the game-changing, relevant and electrifying series comes to an end.
